QuestInfo.name: Deal with the Shadowdealers 3
QuestInfo.0: #bRomero#k of the Shadowdealers in #bDowntown Black Market#k has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: Unfortunately, Romero's plan failed. The Specter's Sword Pieces aren't selling well. Get the #bSpecter Ambassador Scythe#k from the #rReaper Specter#k for Romero to make up the losses.
QuestInfo.2: Romero finally realized who the ace of the Reclamation HQ is. If anything, he's even happier about his business prospects. The deal between the Shadowdealers and Nova should continue to profit both.

0.0: I've been bamboozled! You can't make weapons from the Specter's Sword Pieces... You can't make anything because of their weird powers! Argh... #rI wouldn't have bought piles of these if I knew#k...
0.1: Oh, I bought more from other adventurers, too! And it turns out #rall of them are trash#k! How will I cover this loss? Do you have any good ideas? ...Wait a minute. What about the Specter Ambassador Scythe?
0.2: The Specter Ambassador Scythe can be found on the #rReaper Specter#k. We won't need to melt it down, because it's already such a formidable weapon! We just need to sharpen the blade...and get it, of course. That's where you come in.
0.3: I know it's hard to get. I know the Reaper Specter is super strong! But I have faith (and a lot of capital invested) in you! Get me just #b40 Specter Ambassador Scythes#k!

no.0: Hey, we've come this far together! Help your business partner out!

0.msg: Did you really get the Specter Ambassador Scythe?

1.msg: Such luster! Such sharpness! This must be a superior weapon! It'll fetch a fine price, ahahaha! Thank you very much! You're my savior! #bI don't need the ace of the Reclamation HQ! You're my ace!#k

2.msg: What are you saying? What about the ace of the Reclamation HQ?

3.msg: *gasp* Tonero?! Why are you suddenly talking to me? Are you here to steal my ace? Listen up, the ace only deals with me!

4.msg: Your ace? You mean #b#h0##k? I've been dealing with our friend here for ages.

5.msg: ...What? What do you mean? You've been doing business with the ace of the Reclamation HQ?

6.msg: That's right. I mean, they're right here, aren't they?

7.msg: ...! W-wait! You were the ace of the Reclamation HQ?! It can't be! Why didn't you tell me?

8.msg: I guess they didn't have the chance. You never give anyone that chance.

10.msg: Remember what I always said? A merchant has to listen to others to find a good deal. But you're still...

11.msg: Stop nagging! Anyway, you're saying this friend here is the ace? No wonder... Quietly making me deals from the Nova! It was all for this!

0.msg: The deal went off without a hitch, thanks to you! I see a bright future ahead of me! I look forward to working with you again! Ahahaha!

1.msg: Sigh... Anyway, it was hard for me to deal with the Nova alone due to supply shortages. I guess this is ultimately a good thing.

item.0: You'll be my savior if you can get just #b40 Specter Ambassador Scythes#k!
